records.jp: ……菜々花、大丈夫？
records.en_original: Nanaka, are you okay?
records.en: Nanaka, are you okay?

records.jp: わたし……
謹慎明けたら、任務に戻るから
records.en_original: Once my punishment's over, I'll be back on duty.
records.en: Once my punishment's over, I'll be back on duty.

records.jp: ……もう、ボイコットの理由もないでしょ。<CR>あそこに、樹里は……いないんだから
records.en_original: There isn't even a reason to boycott anymore. Juri's no longer there...
records.en: There isn't even a reason to boycott anymore. Juri's no longer there...

records.jp: 「図書室の閲覧履歴、あれは菜々花か」
records.en_original: So, the library search history was yours?
records.en: So, the library search history was yours?

records.jp: “イローデッドの異灰化事例について”。<CR>そうよ、あれを調べてたのは、わたし……
records.en_original: "Regarding Cases of Eroded Testa Transformation." That's right, the one who was investigating that was me.
records.en: "Regarding Cases of Eroded Testa Transformation." That's right, the one who was investigating that was me.

records.jp: どうにか助けられないか、調べてたのね
records.en_original: You were looking into whether there was any way to save Juri, weren't you?
records.en: You were looking into whether there was any way to save Juri, weren't you?

records.jp: …………回復した事例は一つもない。<CR>完全に異灰化すれば、イローデッドは助からない
records.en_original: There hasn't been a single case of recovery... Once they're fully transformed, an Eroded can't be saved.
records.en: There hasn't been a single case of recovery... Once they're fully transformed, an Eroded can't be saved.

records.jp: わかってる。樹里がもう二度と戻ってこないことも、<CR>わたしが間違ってることも
records.en_original: I know... I know that Juri won't ever come back, and that I'm the one who's wrong.
records.en: I know... I know that Juri won't ever come back, and that I'm the one who's wrong.

records.jp: ……全部、わかってるの
records.en_original: I understand everything...
records.en: I understand everything...

records.jp: わたしが弱いから樹里は死んだ。<CR>全部わたしが悪いの。何もかも、全部……
records.en_original: Juri died because I'm weak. It's all my fault. Everything, absolutely all of it...
records.en: Juri died because I'm weak. It's all my fault. Everything, absolutely all of it...

records.jp: それは違うわ。<CR>菜々花は、樹里の死を乗り越えて前に進もうとしている
records.en_original: That's not true, Nanaka. You're just trying to move forward, past Juri's death.
records.en: That's not true, Nanaka. You're just trying to move forward, past Juri's death.

records.jp: 弱い人には、そんなことできない
records.en_original: Someone weak couldn't do that.
records.en: Someone weak couldn't do that.

records.jp: ……辛いときは、誰だって後ろを向いてしまう。<CR>私も、そうだったから
records.en_original: When things are hard, anyone might turn their back on things. I used to be like that too.
records.en: When things are hard, anyone might turn their back on things. I used to be like that too.

records.jp: そんな、そんなこと……
records.en_original: No, that... That's not...
records.en: No, that... That's not...

records.jp: リーダー？
records.en_original: Leader?
records.en: Leader?

records.jp: 「本当は、クイーンの中で望月さんに会った」
records.en_original: The truth is, I met Juri inside the Queen.
records.en: The truth is, I met Juri inside the Queen.

records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: そっか、新しいリーダーさんだったのか。<CR>アタシを助けに、こんなところまで来てくれるなんて
records.en_original: I see, so you're the new leader. And you came all this way to help me...
records.en: I see, so you're the new leader. And you came all this way to help me...

records.jp: ……アナタ、すごくイイひとなんだね
records.en_original: You're such a good person.
records.en: You're such a good person.

records.jp: 残念だけど……アタシはもう元に戻れない。<CR>わかるんだ。自分の身体のことだから
records.en_original: Sorry, but I can't go back to the way I was. I can tell—it's my body after all.
records.en: Sorry, but I can't go back to the way I was. I can tell—it's my body after all.

records.jp: これ以上、クイーンの意志を食い止めることもできない。<CR>だんだん、“アタシ”がなくなっていく
records.en_original: I can't stop the Queen's will any longer. Little by little, I'm losing what makes me "me."
records.en: I can't stop the Queen's will any longer. Little by little, I'm losing what makes me "me."

records.jp: お願いがあるの。聞いてもらってもいい？
records.en_original: I have a favor to ask. Will you hear me out?
records.en: I have a favor to ask. Will you hear me out?

records.jp: 殺してほしい
records.en_original: I want you to kill me.
records.en: I want you to kill me.

records.jp: もう、抑えられないんだ
records.en_original: I can't hold it back anymore.
records.en: I can't hold it back anymore.

records.jp: 誰にも、迷惑はかけたくないんだよ
records.en_original: I don't want to hurt anyone else.
records.en: I don't want to hurt anyone else.

records.jp: それと……アタシに会ったことは、<CR>ナナには言わないでほしい
records.en_original: And...please, don't tell Nana that you saw me.
records.en: And...please, don't tell Nana that you saw me.

records.jp: 「それでいいのか？」
records.en_original: Are you sure that's what you want?
records.en: Are you sure that's what you want?

records.jp: うん。アタシのせいでナナが<CR>前を向けないなんて、絶対ダメだから
records.en_original: I'm sure. If Nana couldn't move forward because of me, I couldn't stand it.
records.en: I'm sure. If Nana couldn't move forward because of me, I couldn't stand it.

records.jp: ……きっと今、外は大変なことになってるんだよね
records.en_original: I bet things are really crazy out there right now.
records.en: I bet things are really crazy out there right now.

records.jp: 約束は守れなくなったけど……ナナは強いから。<CR>前さえ向ければ、きっと助けになってくれる
records.en_original: I couldn't keep my promise... But Nana is strong. As long as she's facing forward, she'll definitely be able to help.
records.en: I couldn't keep my promise... But Nana is strong. As long as she's facing forward, she'll definitely be able to help.

records.jp: だから……、ナナを……――
records.en_original: So, please...
records.en: So, please...

records.jp: ナナを、よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: Please, take care of Nana.
records.en: Please, take care of Nana.

records.jp: ありがとう。<CR>こんな役回り押し付けて、ごめん
records.en_original: Thank you. Sorry for putting you in this position.
records.en: Thank you. Sorry for putting you in this position.

records.jp: それじゃ――
records.en_original: Well, then...
records.en: Well, then...

records.jp: バイバイ、ナナ。どうか、幸せに――
records.en_original: Goodbye, Nana. Please, be happy.
records.en: Goodbye, Nana. Please, be happy.

records.jp: ナナ……本当に、会ったのね
records.en_original: "Nana"? You really did meet her, didn't you?
records.en: "Nana"? You really did meet her, didn't you?

records.jp: 「信じてくれるのか？」
records.en_original: You believe me?
records.en: You believe me?

records.jp: わたしのことをそう呼ぶのは、あいつだけだもん……
records.en_original: She always called me that...
records.en: She always called me that...

records.jp: ほんと、最後まであいつらしい。<CR>最後まで、わたしのために……
records.en_original: She really was herself, right up until the end. Always putting me first, even at the very last moment...
records.en: She really was herself, right up until the end. Always putting me first, even at the very last moment...

records.jp: ……あいつは、わたしに夢をくれた。
records.en_original: She gave me hope.
records.en: She gave me hope.

records.jp: 誰の助けもいらない、完全無欠のわたしたちになる。<CR>そんな夢をあいつと……
records.en_original: That together, we could become complete, perfect people who don't need anyone's help. That was our dream.
records.en: That together, we could become complete, perfect people who don't need anyone's help. That was our dream.

records.jp: ありがとう、リーダー。伝えてくれて
records.en_original: Thank you for telling me, Leader.
records.en: Thank you for telling me, Leader.

records.jp: ……リーダーが黙ってたこと、<CR>怒るかと思ってたけど
records.en_original: I thought you'd be mad about him keeping quiet.
records.en: I thought you'd be mad about him keeping quiet.

records.jp: 樹里に言われてたんでしょ。<CR>なら、別にいい
records.en_original: But Juri told him not to tell me, right? Then it's fine.
records.en: But Juri told him not to tell me, right? Then it's fine.

records.jp: ……ごめん。わたしのせいで、いろいろ
records.en_original: Sorry for all the trouble I've caused.
records.en: Sorry for all the trouble I've caused.

records.jp: それと……ありがとう。<CR>わたしの未練を断ち切ってくれて
records.en_original: And...thank you for helping me move on.
records.en: And...thank you for helping me move on.

records.jp: ……明日から、前を向く。<CR>いつまでも後ろ向きだと、あいつに怒られちゃうから
records.en_original: Starting tomorrow, I'll face forward. If I keep looking back forever, she'll get mad at me.
records.en: Starting tomorrow, I'll face forward. If I keep looking back forever, she'll get mad at me.

records.jp: 樹里が生きたこの場所を、わたしが守る。<CR>もう、誰にも汚させない
records.en_original: I'll protect this place in memory of Juri. I won't let anyone defile it ever again.
records.en: I'll protect this place in memory of Juri. I won't let anyone defile it ever again.

records.jp: 言っとくけど！　わたし、男のことは<CR>心の底から、ほんっっっとに大っ嫌いだから！！
records.en_original: Just so you know! I really, really, REALLY hate boys from the bottom of my heart!
records.en: Just so you know! I really, really, REALLY hate boys from the bottom of my heart!

records.jp: でも……リーダーは、いいよ。<CR>わたしを理解してくれる人だから
records.en_original: But...I'm fine with you, Leader. Because you actually understand me.
records.en: But...I'm fine with you, Leader. Because you actually understand me.
